reader_summary.headline: My guests today are Matt Perelman and Alex Sloane, Co-founders and Managing Partners of Garnett Station Partners.
reader_summary.overview: My guests today are Matt Perelman and Alex Sloane, Co-founders and Managing Partners of Garnett Station Partners. GSP invests in the trillion-dollar franchise and consumer services industries. Matt and Alex started the firm in 2014 as MBA students when they bought 23 Burger King restaurants.

key_points.text: Since then, they've invested in 26 other multi-unit businesses, from gyms to car washes to funeral homes.
This discussion is a masterclass in franchise investing.
We explore GSP's playbook for creating value, the power of Matt and Alex's partnership, and their approach to scaling businesses for successful exits.
